title: Preference Tuning with Human Feedback on Language, Speech, and Vision Tasks: A Survey

bias_targets.target: LLM Evaluator Bias (Self-preference, Length, and Position Bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Literature review analyzing the biases introduced when using LLMs as automatic judges, specifically noting how judge models tend to favor outputs from their own model family, exhibit preferences for longer sequences (verbosity bias), and favor text in certain positions.

Surveying the state of multilingual and multicultural preference tuning, highlighting the gap in aligning models for non-dominant languages, regional dialects, and code-switching to prevent cultural erasure.
